reuse.why: Adds getRangeAmount in shared/schedules and routes getScheduledAmount through it, but the server sites keep their own missing/number/range dispatch instead of calling the existing getScheduledAmount that already decides all three cases.

duplication.why: Removes all five copies of the midpoint arithmetic in favour of one function; the per-site null/number dispatch that mirrors getScheduledAmount is left duplicated rather than added.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where schedule amount logic already sits.

scope.why: Only the ranged-amount sites, their comments, a focused test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: The rule now has one definition; a maintainer still sees four hand-written dispatch ternaries that could collapse to getScheduledAmount.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions call getRangeAmount inside their own dispatch instead of the existing getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The arithmetic is shared, not reshaped; the remaining duplicated dispatch predates the change.

one_place.where: getRangeAmount in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount and every server site that previously computed the midpoint.
